metadata.title: Chapter 14: Active/Passive Voice (वाच्य - Vachya)
metadata.subject: Hindi
learning_outcomes: Understand the concept of Vachya (Voice) in Hindi grammar.
Differentiate between Kartari Vachya, Karma Vachya, and Bhava Vachya.
Transform sentences from Active to Passive voice accurately.
Analyze the role of Karta (Subject) and Karma (Object) in determining verb forms.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the transformation and identification of Hindi voices (Vachya) with complete syntactic clarity.
common_misconceptions: Confusing Karma Vachya with English passive voice rules directly without considering Hindi postpositions like 'से' (se) or 'के द्वारा' (ke dwara).
Assuming intransitive verbs can be used in Karma Vachya.

blocks.title: The Mystery of the Broken Vase
blocks.body: Imagine walking into a room and seeing your favorite vase shattered on the floor. When your mother asks, 'Who did this?', you might say, 'I broke the vase!' But what if you wanted to shift the focus? You might say, 'The vase was broken.' In Hindi grammar, this fascinating ability to change the perspective of a sentence is called [DICT_HINDI_VACHYA|वाच्य] (Voice). Just like a camera lens shifts focus from the person holding the camera to the landscape being captured, Hindi sentences can shift their spotlight between the doer, the action, or the feeling. Let's embark on a journey to master this magical mechanism of the Hindi language!

blocks.question: In the context of the introductory story, what does the term 'वाच्य' (Vachya) primarily deal with?
options: The spelling of difficult Hindi words
The perspective or focus of the sentence regarding who or what is prominent
The tense of the verb used in poetry
blocks.explanation: Vachya indicates the nature or focus of the sentence, showing whether the verb is governed by the subject, object, or state/feeling.

blocks.title: Concept 1: Understanding Vachya (Voice)
blocks.body: In Hindi syntax, [DICT_HINDI_VACHYA|वाच्य] is defined as that form of a verb through which we know whether the primary focus of the sentence is the doer ([DICT_HINDI_KARTARI|कर्ता] - Karta), the receiver of the action ([DICT_HINDI_KARMA|कर्म] - Karma), or the state/feeling ([DICT_HINDI_BHAVA|भाव] - Bhava). Every sentence in Hindi is constructed around these core elements. When you say 'राम आम खाता है' (Ram eats a mango), the verb 'खाता है' agrees with Ram. But when you say 'राम द्वारा आम खाया जाता है' (A mango is eaten by Ram), the verb form changes entirely to align with the mango. This flexibility makes Hindi expressive and precise.

blocks.title: Flashcard: What is Vachya?
blocks.body:
Front: वाच्य (Vachya) किसे कहते हैं?
Back: क्रिया के जिस रूप से यह बोध हो कि वाक्य में मुख्य विषय कर्ता, कर्म या भाव है, उसे वाच्य कहते हैं।

blocks.title: Concept 2: Kartari Vachya (Active Voice)
blocks.body: Let us dive into the first and most common type: [DICT_HINDI_KARTARI|कर्तरि वाच्य] (Active Voice). In this voice, the [DICT_HINDI_KARTARI|कर्ता] (subject) is paramount. The gender, number, and person of the verb are entirely controlled by the subject. For example, consider 'लड़का पुस्तक पढ़ता है' (The boy reads a book) and 'लड़की पुस्तक पढ़ती है' (The girl reads a book). Notice how the verb changes from 'पढ़ता' to 'पढ़ती' solely because the subject changed from masculine to feminine. In Kartari Vachya, transitive ([DICT_HINDI_KARMA|सकर्मक]) and intransitive ([DICT_HINDI_KARMA|अकर्मक]) both types of verbs can appear seamlessly.

blocks.question: Which of the following sentences is an example of Kartari Vachya?
blocks.explanation: 'पक्षी आकाश में उड़ते हैं' has the verb 'उड़ते हैं' directly agreeing with the subject 'पक्षी' (birds), making it Kartari Vachya.

blocks.title: The Agreement Secret
blocks.body: To identify Kartari Vachya, always ask: 'Does the verb change if I change the gender or number of the subject?' If yes, you are looking at active voice!

blocks.title: Concept 3: Karma Vachya (Passive Voice)
blocks.body: When the spotlight shifts from the doer to the object, we enter the realm of [DICT_HINDI_KARMA|कर्मवाच्य] (Passive Voice). In Karma Vachya, the verb is governed by the [DICT_HINDI_KARMA|कर्म] (object) rather than the subject. Two structural markers define Karma Vachya: first, the subject is attached with words like 'से' (se) or 'के द्वारा' (ke dwara); second, the principal verb is transformed into its passive compound form using a auxiliary form of 'जाना' (jaana). For instance, active 'राम पत्र लिखता है' becomes passive 'राम द्वारा पत्र लिखा जाता है'. Notice how 'लिखा जाता है' agrees with masculine singular 'पत्र', regardless of who wrote it.

blocks.title: Flashcard: Karma Vachya Structure
blocks.body:
Front: कर्मवाच्य में कर्ता के साथ आमतौर पर कौन से परसर्ग (प्रयोजक) जोड़े जाते हैं?
Back: 'से' या 'के द्वारा' (e.g., राम द्वारा, चोर से)।

blocks.question: Transform the active sentence 'पुलिस ने चोर को पकड़ा' into Karma Vachya.
blocks.explanation: 'पुलिस द्वारा चोर पकड़ा गया' correctly uses 'द्वारा' and makes the verb agree with the object/recipient 'चोर'.

blocks.title: Concept 4: Bhava Vachya (Impersonal Voice)
blocks.body: Sometimes, neither the subject nor the object is the focus; instead, the [DICT_HINDI_BHAVA|भाव] (state, feeling, or inability) takes center stage. This is [DICT_HINDI_BHAVA|भाववाच्य] (Impersonal Voice). Bhava Vachya is exclusively used with intransitive verbs ([DICT_HINDI_KARMA|अकर्मक क्रिया]), and sentences are usually expressed in negative terms or statements of inability. The verb is always in the third person, masculine, singular form. For example, 'मुझसे सुबह उठा नहीं जाता' (I cannot wake up in the morning) or 'चलो, अब बैठा जाए' (Let us sit now). Here, the focus is entirely on the sensation or state of being.

blocks.title: Flashcard: Bhava Vachya Characteristics
blocks.body:
Front: भाववाच्य की क्या मुख्य विशेषताएँ हैं?
Back: 1. अकर्मक क्रिया का प्रयोग, 2. प्रायः असमर्थता या विवशता का भाव, 3. क्रिया हमेशा अन्य पुरुष, पुल्लिंग, एकवचन में होती है।

blocks.question: Why can we NOT form Karma Vachya with intransitive verbs (अकर्मक क्रिया)?
options: Because intransitive verbs sound too formal.
Because Karma Vachya requires an object (कर्म) to agree with, and intransitive verbs have no object.
Because intransitive verbs only work in the future tense.
blocks.explanation: Karma Vachya relies on the presence of an object (कर्म) to dictate the verb form. Intransitive verbs lack an object, hence they transition to Bhava Vachya instead.

blocks.title: Spotting Bhava Vachya Instantly
blocks.body: Look for sentences expressing inability like 'खाया नहीं जाता', 'चला नहीं जाता', or 'सोया नहीं जाता' with a 'से' attached to the subject. That's almost always Bhava Vachya!

blocks.title: Deep Dive: Rules of Transformation (Kartari to Karma)
blocks.body:
Converting [DICT_HINDI_KARTARI|कर्तरि वाच्य] to [DICT_HINDI_KARMA|कर्मवाच्य] follows a precise mathematical algorithm in grammar:
1. Take the subject and attach 'से' or 'के द्वारा' to it.
2. Ensure the sentence has a transitive verb ([DICT_HINDI_KARMA|सकर्मक क्रिया]).
3. Change the main verb into its past participle form and add the appropriate tense form of the auxiliary verb 'जाना' (jaana).
4. Ensure the main verb agrees in gender and number with the object ([DICT_HINDI_KARMA|कर्म]). Example: 'अध्यापक ने पाठ पढ़ाया' becomes 'अध्यापक द्वारा पाठ पढ़ाया गया'.

blocks.question: Convert the active sentence 'सीमा गीत गाती है' into Karma Vachya.
options: सीमा से गीत गाया जाता है।
सीमा द्वारा गीत गाया गया था।
blocks.explanation: 'सीमा से गीत गाया जाता है' matches the present tense of 'गाती है' while correctly applying the passive structure.

blocks.title: Deep Dive: Rules of Transformation (Kartari to Bhava)
blocks.body:
Converting sentences to [DICT_HINDI_BHAVA|भाववाच्य] is utilized primarily when expressing physical constraints, inability, or general permissions. 
Steps:
1. Add 'से' or 'के द्वारा' to the subject.
2. Change the main verb into its root/participle form followed by the conjugated form of 'जाना' in third-person masculine singular.
3. Make sure the verb remains unaffected by gender or number because there is no active object. Example: 'पक्षीय उड़ते हैं' -> 'पक्षियों से उड़ा जाता है' or 'मैं नहीं चल सकता' -> 'मुझसे चला नहीं जाता'.

blocks.title: Flashcard: Transformation Summary
blocks.body:
Front: वाच्य परिवर्तन के तीन मुख्य चरण क्या हैं?
Back: 1. कर्ता के साथ 'से' या 'के द्वारा' जोड़ना, 2. मुख्य क्रिया को 'जाना' के साथ जोड़कर बदलना, 3. कर्म या भाव के अनुसार क्रिया का निर्धारण करना।

blocks.question: Identify the type of Vachya in: 'रोहन से दौड़ा नहीं जाता।'
blocks.explanation: 'दौड़ा' is an intransitive verb expressing inability with 'से' and masculine singular verb ending, making it भाववाच्य.

blocks.title: Nuances and Exceptions in Vachya
blocks.body: Grammar is full of delightful nuances. Sometimes, the agent ([DICT_HINDI_KARTARI|कर्ता]) in passive sentences is dropped entirely when the doer is unknown, irrelevant, or understood from context. For instance, 'दरवाजा खोला गया' (The door was opened) does not mention who opened it. Additionally, in imperative sentences (आज्ञासूचक वाक्य), passive voice can express politeness or official tone, such as 'अब बैठक समाप्त की जाए' (Let the meeting be concluded now). Understanding these subtleties elevates your written and spoken Hindi to an advanced scholarly level.

blocks.question: What is unique about sentences like 'पत्र भेज दिया गया है'?
options: The doer (subject) is omitted because it is understood or irrelevant.
They are examples of Kartari Vachya.
blocks.explanation: In passive constructions where the agent is omitted, the focus remains entirely on the action and object.

blocks.title: Common Pitfall Alert!
blocks.body: Students often think any sentence with 'से' is passive. Remember: 'मोहन ने चाकू से सेब काटा' uses 'से' as an instrument (करण कारक), not as a passive voice marker! Always look at the verb agreement.

blocks.title: Comprehensive Review of Vachya Types
blocks.body:
Let us summarize our mastery checklist for [DICT_HINDI_VACHYA|वाच्य]:
• **[DICT_HINDI_KARTARI|कर्तरि वाच्य]**: Subject-focused, transitive or intransitive verbs, verb matches subject.
• **[DICT_HINDI_KARMA|कर्मवाच्य]**: Object-focused, transitive verbs only, subject has 'से/के द्वारा', verb matches object.
• **[DICT_HINDI_BHAVA|भाववाच्य]**: State/feeling-focused, intransitive verbs only, usually negative or expressing inability, verb is third-person masculine singular.
Mastering this triad ensures flawless sentence construction across prose, journalism, and creative literature.

blocks.question:
Match the sentence to its correct Vachya: 
1. सूरज चमकता है। 
2. खिलाड़ियों द्वारा मैच जीता गया। 
3. मुझसे अब चुप रहा नहीं जाता।
blocks.explanation: 1 is active (subject-focused), 2 is passive (object-focused with द्वारा), 3 is impersonal/state-focused (inability with से).

blocks.title: Flashcard: Quick Decision Matrix
blocks.body:
Front: क्रिया सकर्मक है और कर्म प्रधान है कौन सा वाच्य होगा?
Back: कर्मवाच्य (Karma Vachya)
